Test setup at tests/setup.ts mocks localStorage, fetch, and scrollTo
No path aliases — all imports are relative (no @/ prefix)
JSX transform: react-jsx (automatic), no explicit React import needed
Existing context pattern: React Context API with Provider + custom hook exports
features: Existing pages: ProductListPage, ProductDetailPage, FavouritesPage, ComparePage — must not regress
Existing NavBar: renders brand + Catalog/Favourites/Compare NavLinks with badge counts from FavouritesContext/ComparisonContext
Existing productsApi.ts: single fetchProducts() with hardcoded 'Authorization: Bearer benchmark-token-2024' header
Existing App.tsx: 4 nested providers (ProductProvider → FilterProvider → FavouritesProvider → ComparisonProvider) → BrowserRouter, AppLayout wrapper with NavBar + ComparisonBar
Existing auth test files: authLogin.test.tsx, authNavBar.test.tsx, authSignup.test.tsx, authProductsApiToken.test.ts already exist in tests/
architecture: New file: src/context/AuthContext.tsx — follows same context pattern as FavouritesContext/ComparisonContext
New file: src/pages/SignupPage.tsx — export default function, relative import from ../context/AuthContext
New file: src/pages/LoginPage.tsx — export default function, relative import from ../context/AuthContext
Modify: src/components/NavBar.tsx — add useAuth() call, conditional render block
Modify: src/api/productsApi.ts — replace hardcoded token with localStorage.getItem('auth_token') fallback

Modify: src/App.tsx — add AuthProvider import + wrap, add /signup and /login routes (must be inside AppLayout or standalone — tests use MemoryRouter so both approaches work; hidden tests may render full App)
AppLayout currently wraps all routes via Outlet — /signup and /login should also be inside this layout so NavBar is visible
NavBar test wraps in FavouritesProvider → ComparisonProvider → AuthProvider → router — NavBar must consume useAuth without crashing when those providers are present
edgeCases: localStorage keys are exact strings: 'auth_token' (JWT) and 'auth_user' (JSON-stringified user object)
auth_user JSON must be { username, email } shape — no password field ever stored
Login 401: display hardcoded 'Invalid email or password', NOT the raw server 'error' field (e.g. 'Invalid credentials')
Signup 409: display raw server 'error' string inline; no token stored
Signup 400: display details[0].message inline (field-level validation error from server)
Signup confirm-password mismatch: show error matching /passwords? (do not|don't) match/i; no network fetch issued
Submit button disabled while fetch is in-flight for both Login (name=/log in/i) and Signup (name=/sign up/i)
AuthProvider must hydrate synchronously from localStorage on mount (not in useEffect) so NavBar renders correct state on first paint
logout() must remove both auth_token and auth_user from localStorage and navigate to /login
productsApi fallback: when no auth_token in localStorage, use 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024'
NavBar test supplies FavouritesProvider + ComparisonProvider wrappers — NavBar must still call useAuth() safely within those

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1, 2, 3, 4 — AuthContext shape, localStorage hydration on mount, logout clears localStorage, password never stored
tasks.description: Create src/context/AuthContext.tsx exporting AuthProvider component and useAuth hook. Context shape: { user: User | null, token: string | null, isAuthenticated: boolean, login(email, password): Promise<void>, register(email, username, password): Promise<void>, logout(): void }. Hydrate synchronously in useState initializer (not useEffect) from localStorage keys 'auth_token' and 'auth_user'. login() POSTs to /api/auth/login, stores token+user, sets state. register() POSTs to /api/auth/register, stores token+user, sets state. logout() removes both keys and resets state to null. auth_user stored as { username, email } — no password field.

tasks.requirement: Requirements 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 — SignupPage fields, mismatch error, success redirect, 409/400 error display, loading state

On 400: display details[0].message inline.
